crawlNote: Return policy fetched in full. Contact page rendered as the marketing homepage, so escalation details beyond WhatsApp are thin.
summary: boAt is blunt about replacement-only and a 24-hour damage window. The problem is the rest of the site still sounds like a liberal, free-delivery, easy-cancel brand. That gap is the score.

dimensions.label: Internal consistency
dimensions.note: Policy calls itself liberal, then refuses most cancellations. Replacement vs refund wording is at least explicit.

dimensions.label: Help vs marketing
dimensions.note: Homepage tiles say Free Express Delivery and 7-day Replacement. Policy charges shipping under ₹499 and forbids refunds.

dimensions.label: Freshness
dimensions.note: Warranty dates from April 2025 are current enough. “1024-bit” SSL is a generation out of date.

dimensions.label: High-intent coverage
dimensions.note: Replacement, cancellation, pricing-error, delivery, shipping fee. No customer refund path by design.

dimensions.label: Path to a human
dimensions.note: WhatsApp 919667700177 is the visible chat. Contact URL did not yield a dedicated desk page.

dimensions.label: Bot / chat honesty
dimensions.note: WhatsApp deep-link. No labelled bot. Neutral, not a plus.

findings.title: “Liberal cancellation” and “no return or refund” on the same policy
findings.whyItHurts: A buyer who read the heading will believe they can cancel. The body says shipping-started and same-day orders cannot.
findings.fix: Delete the word liberal. Open with “Replacement only. No refunds. Cancel only before we hand the order to shipping.”

evidence.quote: We believe in helping our customers as far as possible, and has therefore a liberal cancellation policy.
Please see that no return or refund shall be provided.
Cancellations request will not be entertained if the orders have already been communicated to the customers and they have initiated the process of shipping them.

findings.title: Damage must be reported within 24 hours
findings.whyItHurts: A weekday delivery at 8pm plus a work day is already past the window. This is the ticket that becomes a 1-star review.
findings.fix: Put the 24-hour damage clock in the order-delivered SMS, not only in the policy.

evidence.quote: Replacement can be made if the customer establishes that the product delivered in defective condition or has a physical damage within 24 hours of receipt of the product

findings.title: Homepage says Free Express Delivery. Policy charges ₹30 under ₹499.
findings.whyItHurts: The asterisk on “Free” is doing all the work. Checkout is where trust dies.

evidence.quote: Shipping charges Rs 30 levied on orders below Rs 499.

findings.title: Security copy still boasts 1024-bit encryption
findings.whyItHurts: Not a customer-loss issue. It is a signal the policy page is not owned.
findings.fix: State TLS 1.2+ and that card data is taken by the gateway, which the same page already says.

evidence.quote: Transactions on the website are protected by SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) and Secure Data Encryption using a 1024-bit process.
